name: Browser Agent (computer_use + research_fetch)
description: Registers two high-level browser tools: computer_use (Playwright + VLM loop for multi-step UI) and research_fetch (Trafilatura + Readability + VLM reconciled content extraction). Wraps the skills/computer-use/ and skills/research-fetch/ shell scripts.

computerUseScript.description: Absolute path to computer-use run.sh (defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/computer-use/run.sh).

researchFetchScript.description: Absolute path to research-fetch run.sh (defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/research-fetch/run.sh).

defaultMaxStepsComputerUse.description: Default MAX_STEPS env for computer_use when not provided by the caller.

timeoutSecondsComputerUse.description: Hard timeout (seconds) for a computer_use invocation. Default 300.

timeoutSecondsResearchFetch.description: Hard timeout (seconds) for a research_fetch invocation. Default 180.
